paras: Introducing our groundbreaking intake system, meticulously engineered for the VW MK8 Golf R and Audi S3 8Y. Tailored to perfection, this is the definitive choice for the 2.0T EA888.4 Engine, offering versatility as an open or closed system.

Air is channeled through our 3.5" high flow air filter, designed with a double cone shape to optimize engine performance and breathing. Experience a significant boost in airflow compared to stock systems, reduced pressure drop, and impressive gains in horsepower and torque. With its enhanced sound and aesthetic appeal, you can open or close the intake cover to suit your preferences. Make it the last intake system you'll ever need with our unparalleled design and performance.
